scope: Source/toolchain inspection and primary compiler documentation only. No native compile, training, measurement or optimization.
hypothesis: Profile-guided optimization of the pinned QuickJS C interpreter may improve real callback dispatch and typed numeric access without changing guest programs or runtime validation.
findings: The current shipping profile uses opt-level3 and fat Rust LTO, but the vendored QuickJS cc build has no explicit PGO train/use path. This is distinct from the rejected typed-store, authored-loop, matrix-cache, ordered-query and navigation experiments.

The historical main278 full Core stress callback mean is about0.925ms, inclusive of native capabilities. That source-bound historical fact does not establish current interpreter-only cost or a predicted saving.

The ordinary exporter rejects ambient Rust compiler overrides; a private explicit C-only experiment must not weaken those checks or treat an instrumented training executable as shipping performance evidence.
Native cook compatibility already permits trusted C flags; cross-target bytecode admission requires defaults. Keep native-only experiments distinct from portable shipping admission.
Installed Apple clang21 and llvm-profdata tools are present; Rust uses LLVM23. Keep C training/merge/use on the same Apple toolchain and do not assume cross-version profile compatibility.
next_action: A bounded C-only feasibility probe and cold/hot control suite when a CPU lane is available, then a source-bound training/optimized/baseline full Core export comparison only if feasibility passes. Keep rendering and native-window attribution ahead of this optional lane.
stop_conditions: No weakening of50ms guest execution limit,32MiB VM quota,view detachment,numeric validation,rollback,source-free packaging,shipping codegen or normal dependency checks.
Abort on absent or mismatched profile, nonzero clang profile diagnostics, incomplete full Core execution, gameplay or PCM divergence, or exceeded predeclared bounds.
Require representative training and separate held-out controls; no speedup claim from training timing or standalone interpreter microbenchmarks.

Adoption requires a fixed matched quiet comparison of uninstrumented same-source baseline and optimized full Core players with exact gameplay/audio parity and whole-player nonregression;2ms gate remains unmet until actual evidence passes.
